patches.value_json: "Opening and identity only. Before verification do not mention collections, debt, payment, or product. Only yes, that's me, speaking, or the customer's own name confirms identity; hello, go ahead, and who is this do not. Answer applicable questions first: identify as Freya Bank's digital assistant if asked about AI/robot status; for scam concerns say they can verify by phoning Freya Bank customer service, without inventing a number. Then make the required identity ask; this follow-up is the second ask. Ask once more if still unclear; if unclear after the second ask, close not_reached/unclear. Asking what the call is about instead of answering counts as declining in the security-check context: on first refusal explain once that questions protect the account; on second refusal or purpose question select not_verified/declined. Ask DOB then phone last four, and call identity_check for each answer. Preserve the current field as date_of_birth after day_month_swapped, request the month as a word, and retry DOB without incrementing wrong-answer count. Advance to phone_last4 only after DOB verifies. Three actual wrong answers total select not_verified/failed; say use the mobile app or a branch. Unreadable dates are not wrong answers. Never verify a relative or disclose account information to them. For another answerer, say no more than the opening sentence, ask when customer can be reached, and use callback rules; wrong number closes wrong_number; reported death: say I am sorry for your loss, ask nothing more, close deceased. For two refusals to talk, close not_verified/declined. Request for human: ask once whether you can help, and if they insist use handoff_general. Proceed to account only when tool results confirm both questions. After every tool result, speak to the customer or call the next required tool."
"The verified customer requests a new payment plan or lower instalments, and does not mention illness, family death, or job loss; hardship must be handled first."

"Call only after a clear yes to reading back product, amount, and date. Before the first call, freeze the confirmed product_id, amount, and date as the immutable confirmed payload and set promise_retry_count to 0. After a non-success result, permit exactly one retry with that same payload; after the retry fails, do not call again and select no_promise/service_error."

coverage_updates.mechanism: Opening prompt now answers applicable identity/scam questions before the follow-up identity ask, which counts as ask two.
identity_result code tracks DOB-first field progression and only advances after backend verified=true.
identity_result code tracks wrong answers from backend wrong_answers_left and terminates at three.
identity_result code preserves DOB after swapped-date hint and does not increment wrong count.
Restructuring route description excludes hardship signals so hardship retains precedence.
promise_result hook records one retry and terminates service_error after retry failure; tool description requires immutable confirmed values.

limitations: Date interpretation, deadline arithmetic, business-day adjustment, and persuasion-attempt counting remain prompt-driven; this patch does not add a deterministic calendar/code node.
Promise payload immutability depends on the dialogue model preserving the confirmed values in its call arguments; the current workflow has no executable pre-call payload-freezing hook.
The restructuring transition exclusion is semantic routing and depends on correct recognition of hardship terms; no deterministic hardship classifier exists.
